oval.why: Balanced proportions, so most shapes work.
frames: Most frame shapes work: wayfarers and soft rectangles are easy picks
hair: Most cuts work: a textured crop or a side part keeps it simple
Medium length with a little texture on top

round.why: Angles and a little height add structure to softer curves.
frames: Frames slightly wider than the cheekbones
hair: Some height on top with shorter sides (a quiff or textured top)
A side part or an off-center sweep

square.why: Curves and softer lines balance a strong jaw.
frames: Finer rims rather than heavy square ones
hair: A side part or soft fringe that breaks up straight lines

oblong.why: Width and a fringe balance a longer shape.
frames: Deeper frames with a strong top line
hair: Medium length with some volume at the sides
A fringe or textured top that isn't very tall

heart.why: Detail lower on the face balances a wider forehead.
hair: Medium length with fullness near the ears
A side-swept fringe; a beard adds balance at the jaw

diamond.why: Frames and hair that add width at the brow and chin balance strong cheekbones.
frames: Frames with detail on the top line
hair: A fuller top or a fringe
Some length at the sides; a beard adds width at the chin
